summary: Decision: Pulsar joins the confidential/embargoed set with Orbit. Never reference it in company-wide or external updates until launch; core-team channel only.
Decision: do not commit a Vega GA date until the proration Sev-1 is closed and QA signs off. The date question is escalated, not answered by the PM alone.
Decision: backlog batches larger than 10 stories go to sprint planning to be sized, not straight into the tracker.
Decision: Orbit stays embargoed and is never referenced in company-wide or external updates until launch.
